# Contributing to Seed-VC iPad App

Thank you for your interest in contributing to this project! We welcome contributions from the community.

## How to Contribute

### Reporting Bugs

Before creating bug reports, please check existing issues as your bug may already be reported and fixed.

When reporting a bug, include:
- A clear and descriptive title
- Steps to reproduce the bug
- Expected vs actual behavior
- Device and iOS version information
- Screenshots if applicable

### Suggesting Features

Feature suggestions are welcome! Please create an issue with:
- A clear feature name
- Use case and motivation
- Any relevant examples or references

### Pull Requests

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a new branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`)
3. Make your changes
4. Test thoroughly
5. Commit with descriptive messages
6. Push to your fork
7. Open a Pull Request

## Code Style

- Follow Swift best practices
- Use meaningful variable and function names
- Add comments for complex logic
- Keep functions small and focused

## Testing

- Test on both simulator and device
- Test on multiple iOS versions
- Ensure backward compatibility

## Documentation

- Update README if necessary
- Add inline comments for new features
- Update CHANGELOG if applicable

## Questions?

Feel free to open an issue or discussion for any questions!

Thank you for contributing! 🎉
